description: Reference label vocabulary for the 177-track evaluation dataset. All fields are set to PENDING in the scaffold; human annotators fill them in.

object_class.description: Human-verified semantic class. May differ from YOLO label.

physical_mobility.description: Whether the object is physically capable of moving. A chair is MOVABLE even if it never moves during the recording.

observed_motion.description: Whether the object was actually observed moving during the recording. Must be determined from temporal evidence (multiple frames), not from a single crop. Raw image displacement alone is insufficient because camera motion produces apparent object motion.

visibility.description: Best visibility achieved across representative observations.

track_identity_validity.description: Whether the track consistently refers to the same physical object. QUESTIONABLE if suspected identity switch. INVALID if clearly wrong.

evidence_sufficiency.description: Whether the representative observations provide enough visual evidence to make a confident label decision.

annotation_confidence.description: Overall annotator confidence in the assigned labels.

annotator_notes.description: Free-text notes, concerns or caveats for this track.

representative_observation_ids.description: obs_id values selected as representative for this track.
